item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 16/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China this morning. It will be mainly fine during the day over the region. The monsoon is expected to strengthen on Monday and Tuesday. It will be windy over the coastal areas. Under the persistent influence of the monsoon, it will be cool in the morning and at night and cloudier over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 16/02 (Sunday)
Wind: North force 2 to 3, east force 4 later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches and coastal fog in the morning. Sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 17 - 24 C
R.H. range: 55 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
